zh: 新墨西哥州立大学（，缩写：NMSU），简称为新墨州大，是一所创建于西元1888年，男女合校的美国公立大学，位于美国新墨西哥州南部的第二大城拉斯克鲁塞斯，与新墨西哥大学为该州两所研究型大学.
学校原名拉斯克鲁塞斯学院，为太空总署太空奖学金大学(NASA space-grant university)及州政府赠地大学，全校占地超过6,000英亩. 距离德州西部的边境大城艾帕索车程约40分钟.

西元1888年，拉斯库塞斯学院(Las Cruces College)从一栋土坯楼房中诞生. 创立时最早是一所农业院校. 1889年更名为“新墨西哥农工学院”(New Mexico College of Agriculture and Mechanic Arts). 1891年2月，该校第一座教学大楼—麦卡费馆(Mcfie Hall)落成，该馆在1910年大火中毁坏. 该校历经艰苦，尤其在1929年经济大萧条中，承受过巨大的财政与政治压力，但新墨州大农学人(Aggies)仍然坚持不懈. 并在第二次世界大战中，学校临时建成军事训练基地，为同盟国正义事业付出过辛劳汗水. 二战后，学校情势逐渐好转，并发展成今日规模庞大，教学体系完善，教育经费充足的综合性公立大学. 2016年秋季学期，新墨西哥州立大学附属之Burrell医学院招收了第一届学生.

* 农业,消费者与环境科学学院 (College of Agricultural, Consumer and Environmental Sciences) * 人文与科学学院 (College of Arts and Sciences) * 商学院 (College of Business) * 教育学院 (College of Education) * 工学院 (College of Engineering) * 健康与社会服务学院 (College of Health and Social Services) * 荣誉学院 (Honors College) * 推广教育学院 (College of Extended Learning)
* 研究所 (Graduate School) * 医学院 (Burrell College of Osteopathic Medicine at NMSU)
en: New Mexico State University (NMSU or NM State) is a public, land-grant, research university in Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States. Founded in 1888, it is the state's oldest public institution of higher education, and was the original land-grant university in the region. NMSU is a university system, with its main campus in Las Cruces and satellite campuses in Alamogordo, Doña Ana County, and Grants. Through the NMSU Cooperative Extension Service, it has centers or programs in all 33 counties in the state.

Initially established as Las Cruces College, NMSU was designated a land-grant college in 1889 and renamed New Mexico College of Agriculture and Mechanic Arts; it received its present name in 1960. NMSU offers over 180 degree programs, including 28 doctoral, 58 master's, and 96 baccalaureate programs. It had approximately 22,711 enrolled in Fall 2024, with a faculty-to-student ratio of roughly 1 to 16. New Mexico State's athletic teams, the Aggies, compete at the NCAA Division I level in Conference USA.

As of 2025, NMSU has a research activity designation of "R1: Doctoral Universities – Very High Research Spending and Doctorate Production". NMSU is the lead institute for the New Mexico National Space Grant Consortium.

Hiram Hadley, an Earlham College-educated teacher from Indiana, founded Las Cruces College. Upon its opening on September 17, 1888, it included an elementary school, a university preparatory school, and a business school; it "was not a college in the contemporary meaning of the word."

A year later, the Territorial Assembly of New Mexico provided for the establishment of an agricultural college and agricultural experiment station with the Rodey Act of 1889. It stated: "Said institution is hereby located at or near the town of Las Cruces in the County of Doña Ana, upon a tract of land of not less than one hundred (100) acres." Designated as the land-grant college for New Mexico under the Morrill Act, it was named the New Mexico College of Agriculture and Mechanic Arts.
